seo_title: Gorgeous Ghost: Making a Glam Space Opera | Kris Krüg
excerpt_and_seo_description: How I turned one locked song and a pile of AI footage into Gorgeous Ghost, a 69-second glam space opera for Vancouver’s BC + AI Film Club.
